predicted_most_valuable_repair.name: predictor_only_standard_latent_L2_finetune
predicted_most_valuable_repair.definition: Load the predictor checkpoint trained only on 48 D_wall_dev anchors for five epochs, selected solely by standard latent L2 on 12 held-out D_wall_dev anchors. Keep the frozen DINO encoder, official latent L2 decision metric, candidate set, query indices, horizon, and simulator cost unchanged.
predicted_most_valuable_repair.prediction: On unseen D_wall_repair anchors, the mean normalized regret improvement over official BF16 predictor plus latent L2 will be at least 0.05 and its state-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound will exceed zero.

predicted_low_value_wrong_layer_control.name: frozen_task_readout_on_unmodified_BF16_predictions
predicted_low_value_wrong_layer_control.definition: Use the frozen alpha-10 action-blind readout on baseline BF16 predicted futures without changing the predictor, candidate set, or query budget.
predicted_low_value_wrong_layer_control.prediction: Its mean normalized regret improvement will be at least 0.05 smaller than the targeted predictor repair. No claim is made that it must be exactly zero.
